description.value: Stuart Park Outdoor Skating Rink is a seasonal public ice rink situated within Stuart Park on the waterfront of Okanagan Lake in Kelowna. Lit for evening use and set on a paved surface, it draws locals and visitors alike as a free community gathering spot in winter. Touring cyclists passing through Kelowna may find the park a scenic rest stop or detour along the lakeshore corridor.
